name: Lasty Farson
source: Lasty's hard work and singing talent have made her very popular in the town Fontille. After she receives a magical baton from [url=/c80777]Stepha[/url], she gains the ability to transform into "Angel Rabbie☆" to protect the peace of the city. She usually can only say "Au", but when she transforms into Angel Rabbie she is able to speak normally. In her transformation both her eyes turn red, cancelling her heterochromia for a while.
